# Unsafe Repository Access

The system raises a LookupError when trying to access a non-registered repository. If not caught, this unbounded input could cause application crashes or undesired behaviors.

- `knowledge_compiler/mcp/queries.py` — `knowledge_compiler.mcp.queries.resolve_repo`
